verdict.rationale: Fellow provides building blocks for background automation — webhooks that fire on events like AI notes or action-item completion, plus a REST API and Super Admin API for programmatic access — and its core AI features (summaries, action items) already run automatically after meetings. However, there's no evidence of a dedicated automation/workflow builder or agent orchestration layer where an AI-native user configures multi-step autonomous tasks; the MCP server is described as a user-initiated Q&A interface, not an autonomous background agent. Missing for 10: a first-class automation/workflow configuration UI, evidence of scheduled or trigger-based agentic task chains, and confirmation that MCP or API usage can run unattended without a user query.
